title: LMS-NG MQTT envelope v2 (open base -- assembled roots close it)
description: Common fields on every MQTT payload except 'will' (which has its own minimal shape, see will.schema.json). This base is intentionally OPEN (no additionalProperties:false here); each concrete payload schema (state.schema.json etc.) composes this with allOf and closes the ASSEMBLED shape with unevaluatedProperties:false, per revised plan section A.11 and test C03 -- closing every layer independently is the JSON Schema footgun [T2] this design avoids.

messageId.description: Created once before durable enqueue. A retry re-sends the identical bytes under the identical messageId -- this is the field telemetry.ingest_receipt dedupes on (revised plan section A.5).

elevatorId.description: Required key present on every payload; value is UUID for elevator-scoped messages and null only where the concrete schema explicitly allows it (Gateway-lifecycle events).

producerId.description: Identity of the registered installation producing this stream -- assigned by the Backend at enrollment, not self-declared by the Gateway (revised plan section A.6).

producerEpoch.description: Incremented only by an explicit re-enrollment (operator action after e.g. SQLite loss), never by a plain process restart (revised plan section A.6, test O03).

bootId.description: One per agent process lifetime. Diagnostic only -- NEVER used for ordering or dedup by a consumer (that is streamId/streamSeq's job). Kept purely so a human can tell which process instance emitted a message.

streamId.description: Identifies which durable counter this message's streamSeq belongs to. One elevator's telemetry stream and the Gateway's own lifecycle stream are DIFFERENT streamIds -- their sequence spaces must never be compared to each other (revised plan section A.2).

eventTime.description: The time the Gateway process received/derived this record. NEVER claimed as the exact physical instant a contact changed (revised plan section A.2, test O02).

observedAt.description: For most messages equal to eventTime; kept distinct for the case where a value is derived/re-emitted later than it was originally observed (e.g. backlog replay), so a consumer can tell 'when this fact was true' from 'when it was decided/re-sent'.

sourceRef.description: Present for LIVE/IMPORT origin so a crash-recovery or reprocessing job can locate exactly which raw record this came from (revised plan section A.6/B.6, test G07).
